_help.stackedAspect: Screen shape that switches layouts: when the free space is this many times taller than wide (or more), the seed tray goes BELOW the board; otherwise it goes BESIDE it. 1.15 = slightly taller than square.
_help.trayTileMin: Smallest a seed in the tray can get, in pixels (44 = comfortable finger size). Tray seeds are REAL SIZE — the same width as a hex on the board — and never smaller than this. If 8 don't fit in a row they wrap to 2 rows of 4 before they shrink.
_help.trayGap: Space between seeds in the tray, in pixels.
_help.sidePanelShare: In the side-by-side layout, how much of the width the tray panel takes (0.3 = 30%).
_help.boardMargin: Empty space around the board, in hex sizes.
_help.dragLift: When dragging with a finger, how far above your finger the piece floats (pixels), so your finger doesn't hide it.
_help.dragStartDistance: How far (pixels) you must move before a press becomes a drag instead of a tap.
_help.promptGap: Tray below the board (phone portrait): empty space between the board and the instruction text, in pixels, so the board doesn't crowd the words.
_help.bottomRoom: Empty space kept clear under the tray and buttons, in pixels, ON TOP of the phone's own safe area (and the usual small gap), so dragging a seed up or tapping a bottom button doesn't start the phone's home/back gesture. 24 clears Android and iPhone gesture bars.
_help.edgeMargin: Empty space kept round the edges of the game screen (top, sides and bottom), in pixels, on top of the phone's safe area — so the portrait, the Menu button, the board and the tray never crowd the edge. Big screens use edgeMarginShare when that is more.
_help.edgeMarginShare: On a big screen the edge margin grows with it: this share of the screen's SHORTER side (0.035 = 3.5%: about 32 px on a 900-tall desktop), whenever that is more than edgeMargin. With the tray BESIDE the board, the width left over is shared out evenly: edge | board | tray | edge.
